sender_scopes.P2_EXTRACELLULAR_EXTENDED: S1/S2 and secreted == YES or extracellular == YES

receptor_competence.expression_layer: Phase2A2 patient-celltype mean of public normalized-and-ceiled expression
receptor_competence.RECEPTOR_COMPETENT: PE detection proportion >= 0.50 and PE detected n >= 3
receptor_competence.RECEPTOR_WEAK: not competent and (PE detection proportion >= 0.20 or PE detected n >= 2)

target_compatibility.background: genes estimable in both EOPE and LOPE for the cell type and present in the NicheNet matrix
target_compatibility.shared_statistic: mean of separately z-standardized corrected EOPE and LOPE moderated t
target_compatibility.score: mean NicheNet target-rank percentile within frozen module weighted by absolute shared statistic
target_compatibility.coverage: at least min(15, ceiling(0.60 * frozen module genes)) measured module genes and at least 10 positive-potential module targets
target_compatibility.TARGET_COMPATIBLE: competent LR plus weighted score >= 0.60 plus family BH FDR < 0.10
target_compatibility.TARGET_DIRECTIONAL_TREND: competent LR plus weighted score >= 0.55 without full criteria
target_compatibility.target_edge_rule: positive potential and at or above ligand-specific background 95th percentile

signed_network.tf_target: CollecTRI via OmniPath 2026-08-15 directed unambiguous signed interactions
signed_network.cytosig: core non-expanded signature; exact case-insensitive ligand-column match only
signed_network.REVERSAL_SUPPORTED: at least one evaluable source predicts reversal and no evaluable source predicts concordance
signed_network.DISEASE_CONCORDANT_POTENTIAL: at least one evaluable source predicts concordance and no evaluable source predicts reversal
signed_network.SIGNED_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: no evaluable source, mixed direction, or source conflict

candidate_hierarchy.TIER_A_DIRECTIONAL_RESCUE_CANDIDATE: P1 plus competent receptor plus TARGET_COMPATIBLE plus REVERSAL_SUPPORTED plus R1/R2A
candidate_hierarchy.TIER_B_COMPATIBILITY_CANDIDATE: competent receptor plus TARGET_COMPATIBLE plus SIGNED_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT plus R1/R2A
candidate_hierarchy.TIER_C_EXTENDED_EXTRACELLULAR: target-compatible axis restricted to P2/P3 and/or R2B

gate_rule.GO_TO_PHASE4B: at least one Tier A supported by two independent signed sources and no critical risk
gate_rule.GO_TO_PHASE4B_WITH_RESTRICTIONS: at least one Tier A from one signed source or at least five Tier B candidates, with resources valid
gate_rule.REVISE_INTEGRATION_FRAMEWORK: valid frozen inputs but fewer than five Tier B and no Tier A, or signed resources unusable
gate_rule.NO_GO_INTEGRATION: freeze invalid, no receptor-compatible axes, or critical provenance failure
